story: The pace was high immediately after the flag dropped, with six riders managing to form the breakaway. Soudal Quick-Step and Van Baarle in particular kept the gap under control. After the break was caught with 60 km remaining, several attacks followed, and Lauryssen quickly opened up a gap. However, he was caught with just 8 km to go. It all came down to a bunch sprint, which was won by Kooij.
